row.name: Flamer Fuel
row.description: A highly combustible gas mixture made for use in flamethrowers. Can be dispensed to a Flamer Fuel Canister/Tank, or into a Chemical Storage Vessel. Kinetic Breach (Pierced/Slashed): The pressurized tank rapidly leaks highly flammable gel. It creates a slippery 2-yard radius puddle around the wearer. Anyone moving through this hex must make a DX-2 roll or fall prone. Ignition / Energy Breach (Shot by Blaster): The fuel instantly violently ignites. Damage: The wearer takes 4d burning damage. Area Effect: The blast creates a 2-yard radius fireball dealing 2d burning damage to anyone caught inside. Lingering Flame: The wearer (and anyone who failed to Dodge the area effect) catches fire, taking 1d-1 burning damage per second until they take a full turn to drop and roll (requires a DX roll) or are successfully doused.
